name: VibeCart
description: Protocol-first commerce adapter for custom/headless Stripe storefronts, with trusted catalog pricing, durable multi-item carts, and hosted checkout.
limitations: reference public catalog is demo/pilot data unless a merchant configures VIBECART_CATALOG_URL
inventory management is not a VibeCart platform service
automatic shipping-rate calculation is not a VibeCart platform service
returns/refunds lifecycle is not a complete VibeCart platform service
public UCP order lookup is advertised only when its Cloud and permalink dependencies are configured
